meta.description: Phenylketonuria keyword clusters. Spans the BH4 / pegvaliase / sepiapterin pharmacotherapy axis, lifetime Phe-restricted diet + medical-food regimen, neurocognitive / mood impacts of high Phe in adults, maternal-PKU planning, and the lost-to-follow-up adult population. Parent_theme / parent_subtheme reference the codebook.json @ 2.0 taxonomy.

clusters.label: Sapropterin (Kuvan)
clusters.description: Synthetic BH4 (tetrahydrobiopterin) cofactor for residual PAH activity — approved 2007, the first PKU pharmacotherapy. Effective only in BH4-responsive patients. BioMarin.

clusters.label: Pegvaliase (Palynziq)
clusters.description: Pegylated phenylalanine ammonia lyase enzyme substitution therapy — daily subcutaneous injection for adults with uncontrolled Phe. REMS for anaphylaxis. BioMarin.

clusters.label: Sepiapterin (Sephience)
clusters.description: Synthetic precursor of BH4 — FDA-approved 2024 for PKU across the responsiveness spectrum. PTC Therapeutics.

clusters.label: Phe-free medical foods / formula
clusters.description: Phe-free amino-acid mixes and glycomacropeptide (GMP) products that supply non-Phe protein — the daily backbone of PKU diet management.

clusters.label: Phe-restricted diet (low-protein)
clusters.description: Lifetime restriction of dietary phenylalanine — low-protein diet excluding meat, dairy, eggs, nuts, legumes, regular bread and pasta.

clusters.label: Low-protein medical foods (bread / pasta / rice)
clusters.description: Modified low-protein staples — Loprofin bread, Cambrooke pasta, Promin rice — that carry minimal Phe.

clusters.label: Large neutral amino acids (LNAAs)
clusters.description: Branched / aromatic amino-acid supplements that compete with Phe for blood-brain-barrier transport — adult adjunct in some regimens.

clusters.label: PKU gene therapy / gene editing pipeline
clusters.description: Investigational gene therapy and gene editing programs — HMI-103 (Homology Medicines, integration), BBP-789 (BridgeBio / Generation Bio), VTX-803 (Voyager / others). Early Phase 1/2.

clusters.label: Phe levels in target
clusters.description: Getting blood Phe into recommended range (US 120-360 µmol/L lifetime; some EU guidelines tighter for kids and pregnancy) — the central measure of treatment working.

clusters.label: Dietary liberalization on treatment
clusters.description: Being able to eat foods previously off-limits — pizza, chicken, regular bread, ice cream — after BH4 response, pegvaliase, or sepiapterin.

clusters.label: Brain fog clearing / cognitive lift
clusters.description: Adults reporting clearer thinking, focus, energy after Phe drops — the felt cognitive payoff of pegvaliase or sepiapterin.

clusters.label: Daily injection burden (Palynziq)
clusters.description: The lived burden of daily subcutaneous Palynziq injections — needles, sites, timing, travel.

clusters.label: Pegvaliase hypersensitivity / anaphylaxis
clusters.description: Hypersensitivity reactions — including anaphylaxis — drive the Palynziq REMS, mandatory epinephrine carriage, and gradual induction.

clusters.label: Pegvaliase induction / titration
clusters.description: The months-long gradual dose-titration phase up to maintenance dosing — a known adherence challenge.

clusters.label: Injection-site reactions
clusters.description: Local redness, bruising, lumps, itching at Palynziq injection sites — the most common adverse event.

clusters.label: Arthralgia (pegvaliase)
clusters.description: Joint pain and arthralgia commonly reported on Palynziq, sometimes severe enough to drive dose reduction or discontinuation.

clusters.label: Medical food taste / texture
clusters.description: Taste, smell, mouthfeel, and bitterness of phe-free amino-acid mixes — a chronic adherence pain point especially for teens and adults.

clusters.label: Pill / dose burden
clusters.description: Number of Kuvan or Sephience tablets per day, plus formula doses, plus low-protein meal prep — daily regimen load.

clusters.label: BH4-responsiveness testing
clusters.description: Trial of sapropterin or genotype-based prediction to identify BH4-responsive patients — gates Kuvan and influences Sephience use.

clusters.label: PAH genotype / mutation
clusters.description: PAH-gene sequencing — informs disease severity (classical vs. mild vs. mHPA) and predicts BH4 responsiveness for some variants.

clusters.label: Medical food insurance / state coverage
clusters.description: State-by-state insurance coverage variability for medical foods — Phe-free formula often not covered as medication. State medical-food laws.

clusters.label: Metabolic / PKU specialty clinic access
clusters.description: Distance to a PKU-experienced metabolic clinic — many adults travel hours to maintain care.

clusters.label: Palynziq REMS / prescriber bottleneck
clusters.description: REMS-certified prescribers required, in-clinic first dose, epinephrine training — barriers to starting and continuing pegvaliase.

clusters.label: Cost of medical foods
clusters.description: Out-of-pocket cost of Phe-free formula and modified low-protein staples — historically thousands of dollars per year per patient.

clusters.label: Dietary freedom as goal
clusters.description: Wanting to eat normal foods / drop formula as the central pull of pegvaliase or sepiapterin.

clusters.label: Cognitive preservation goal
clusters.description: Preserving cognition, focus, and mental health as motivation for lifelong Phe control — the central modern argument for diet-for-life.

clusters.label: Maternal PKU / pregnancy planning
clusters.description: Tight Phe control before and during pregnancy to prevent maternal PKU syndrome — fetal microcephaly, intellectual disability, congenital heart defects.

clusters.label: Blood Phe levels
clusters.description: Phenylalanine blood concentration — the single most-mentioned biomarker in PKU patient and clinical conversation.

clusters.label: Brain fog / executive function (high Phe)
clusters.description: High-Phe cognitive symptoms in adults — brain fog, slow thinking, trouble focusing, word-finding, executive-function dips.

clusters.label: Mood / irritability with high Phe
clusters.description: Irritability, anxiety, depressive symptoms, mood swings tied to high Phe — among the most felt symptoms in adult PKU.

clusters.label: Headache / migraine (high Phe)
clusters.description: Headaches and migraines that track with elevated Phe.
variants: head hurts when phe is high

clusters.label: Eczema / skin issues
clusters.description: Eczema, dry skin, and rashes more common in untreated or poorly controlled PKU.

clusters.label: Mousy odor (untreated)
clusters.description: The classic mousy or musty body / urine odor of untreated severe PKU — rare today thanks to NBS.

clusters.label: Anxiety / depression (chronic)
clusters.description: Clinical anxiety and depression — both Phe-mediated and reactive — at higher prevalence in adult PKU.

clusters.label: ADHD / attention
clusters.description: ADHD-spectrum and attention difficulties more frequent in PKU, including after years of poor control.

clusters.label: Low bone density / osteopenia
clusters.description: Reduced bone density on long-term low-protein diet, often complicated by formula calcium / vitamin D intake variation.

clusters.label: Nutritional deficiencies
clusters.description: B12, iron, zinc, calcium, omega-3, choline, and selenium gaps that crop up on Phe-restricted diet — especially when patients skip formula.

clusters.label: Overweight / metabolic comorbidity
clusters.description: High-carb low-protein-PKU diet drives weight gain and metabolic comorbidity in many adults.

clusters.label: Phe target range
clusters.description: Recommended lifetime Phe target range — US 120-360 µmol/L per ACMG guidance; tighter for pediatrics and pregnancy; debated for adults.

clusters.label: Diet for life (lifetime management)
clusters.description: Recognition that PKU is a lifetime condition requiring continuous treatment — the modern reversal of 1970s-80s 'off the diet' practice.

clusters.label: Classical / mild PKU / mHPA
clusters.description: Severity gradient — classical PKU vs. mild PKU vs. mild hyperphenylalaninemia (mHPA / non-PKU HPA) — drives treatment intensity and BH4 responsiveness odds.

clusters.label: Newborn screening / heel-prick
clusters.description: PKU was the original NBS condition — caught on the Guthrie test / heel-prick. The detection-at-birth story is central to PKU identity.

clusters.label: How Phe affects the brain
clusters.description: Mechanism — Phe crossing the blood-brain barrier, competing with LNAAs, depleting tyrosine / tryptophan, affecting dopamine and serotonin synthesis, white-matter changes.

clusters.label: Lost-to-follow-up adults
clusters.description: Adults who left clinic and diet in teens or 20s — often the historic 'off the diet' generation — returning to care, sometimes after symptoms or before pregnancy.

clusters.label: Eating socially / dining out
clusters.description: Navigating restaurants, holidays, parties, travel, dating — the social side of a Phe-restricted diet.

clusters.label: Childhood food envy / school lunch
clusters.description: Childhood and teen experiences — separate lunches, watching friends eat birthday cake, summer-camp food — that shape long-term PKU identity.

clusters.label: Disclosure / explaining PKU
clusters.description: Decisions about telling employers, dates, friends, in-laws — and the constant explaining-PKU-to-people burden.

clusters.label: Invisible illness (PKU)
clusters.description: PKU as an invisible disease — adults look fine, leading to disbelief and minimization.
variants: but you can eat that right

clusters.label: National PKU Alliance (NPKUA)
clusters.description: National PKU Alliance — US umbrella patient advocacy organization, conference, family advocates.

clusters.label: National PKU News / NPKU Foundation
clusters.description: National PKU News, the NPKU Foundation, Children's PKU Network, and local family chapters.

clusters.label: PKU Perspectives / online community
clusters.description: PKU Perspectives, Facebook PKU groups, Reddit r/PKU, Discord servers — where adults share daily-management hacks and connect.

clusters.label: World PKU Day / events
clusters.description: World PKU Day (June 28) and indication-specific awareness events.

clusters.label: Metabolic dietitian relationship
clusters.description: Close, multi-year relationship with a specialty metabolic dietitian — often the most-trusted point of contact in PKU care.

clusters.label: Phe-tracking apps (How Much Phe / Accugo)
clusters.description: How Much Phe, Accugo, Cambrooke PKU Manager, and homemade spreadsheets used to log Phe intake and stay in range.

clusters.label: Home Phe testing / mail-in blood spot
clusters.description: Home blood-spot collection mailed to lab — the dominant Phe-monitoring modality for adults outside clinic visits.

clusters.label: Phe exchange counting
clusters.description: Counting Phe in exchanges (1 exchange = 15 mg Phe in US, 50 mg in UK) — the core day-to-day arithmetic of the PKU diet.

clusters.label: Label reading / aspartame
clusters.description: Label reading for hidden Phe — including aspartame in diet drinks and chewing gum (the 'phenylketonurics: contains phenylalanine' warning).

clusters.label: Transition pediatric → adult care
clusters.description: Handoff from pediatric metabolic clinic to adult care — a known failure point that drives lost-to-follow-up.

clusters.label: PKU trial awareness
clusters.description: Awareness of ongoing or upcoming PKU trials — sepiapterin extensions, pegvaliase next-gens, gene-therapy programs.

clusters.label: Trial travel burden
clusters.description: PKU trials are concentrated at a handful of academic metabolic centers — travel, lodging, time off work as the recurring barrier.

clusters.label: Diet protocols in trials
clusters.description: Trial protocols requiring strict Phe loading, washout, or stabilization phases — challenging diet logistics that gate enrollment and retention.

clusters.label: Gene therapy hope / cautious optimism
clusters.description: Anticipation around in-vivo PKU gene therapy / editing — paired with caution about safety, durability, and immune response.

clusters.label: Phe reduction as trial endpoint
clusters.description: Blood Phe reduction as the headline PKU-trial endpoint — sometimes paired with diet liberalization or neurocognitive secondaries.
